tools.name: open_in_vscode
tools.description: Open the current project in Visual Studio Code

tools.name: count_loc
tools.description: Count lines of code in the project, grouped by file extension
tools.command: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Exclude node_modules,.git,dist,build | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.css','.html','.py','.json','.md','.yml','.yaml' } | Group-Object Extension | Select-Object Name, @{N='Files';E={$_.Count}}, @{N='Lines';E={($_.Group | ForEach-Object { (Get-Content $_.FullName | Measure-Object -Line).Lines } | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum }} | Format-Table -AutoSize"

tools.name: find_todos
tools.description: Search the project for TODO, FIXME, HACK, and XXX comments
tools.command: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Exclude node_modules,.git,dist,build | Select-String -Pattern 'TODO|FIXME|HACK|XXX' -CaseSensitive | Group-Object Filename | ForEach-Object { $_.Group | ForEach-Object { \"$($_.Filename):$($_.LineNumber) $($_.Line.Trim())\" } }"

tools.name: check_disk_usage
tools.description: Show disk usage of the project directory
tools.command: powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Directory | ForEach-Object { $dir = $_.FullName; $size = (Get-ChildItem $dir -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum; if ($size -gt 0) { \"{0:N2} MB — {1}\" -f ($size / 1MB), $_.Name } } | Sort-Object -Descending"

tools.name: git_quick_log
tools.description: Show a colorful, compact git log with graph

tools.name: show_uncommitted
tools.description: Show detailed diff of uncommitted changes
